critical_code_review_comments: leagueCompute.client.js → starterPointsByPid() (lines 103-126): correctly loosened. Now returns a non-null map for any entry whose starters[] array is non-empty, defaulting per-slot to 0 when starters_points is missing/empty or a particular index is non-numeric. The map always covers EVERY starter pid (using `out[pid] = (out[pid]||0) + val`), so gamesStarted counts correctly even on weeks with no scoring data. Defensive sum guards against the same pid appearing in two starter slots. Comments and contract match implementation — well documented.

records-player/+page.svelte: PPG values are computed from `gamesStarted` / `points` rather than averaged at row time — correct because gamesStarted is now reliably populated by the loosened helper. For the by-team table, PPG is intentionally rendered as a `.ppg-sub` sub-line under each PTS cell instead of a new column, preserving the 5-column layout per the iteration_7 spec.

matchups optimization (line 213 onwards): getPlayersNba() is kicked off WITHOUT await before loadSeasons() walks the chain → cold-cache load dropped from prior 5-15s to ~2s in this test. computeMatchupsForLeagueWeek() rosterMap+leagueMeta+matchups parallelization via Promise.all is correctly bundled and does not regress data correctness (top-3, bust, bench-burn values all still match prior iteration_6 sanity numbers).

Minor: the Bust of the Week (Khaman Maluach 2.75 from Gilbert Arenas) is identical to iteration_6's value, confirming the loosened helper does NOT change bust selection — bust is still derived from starter-only scoring as intended.

Sub-line `.ppg-sub` rendering uses muted styling differentiated from the big PTS number — visually clean and not cramping the column width. Tooltips on the GS / PPG (Started) <th> elements explain the new metric (good a11y / discoverability).
